issue.title: test_auto_refresh_merge_live_hints_and_warmup_release_obsolete_payloads leaked a FinalizerInventoryWorkerResult once in a scoped check
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-1ux.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4) of epic sase-1ux; filed by the sase-1ux land agent. The phase's recorded check 033db6ea7cbd381ea400582027fd159a classified the node NEW (no owner): the test's obsolete-payload GC assertion found one leftover FinalizerInventoryWorkerResult. The phase judged the leftover to be file-completion GC unrelated to row-signals. A local rerun by the phase passed, and three serial reruns by the land agent at 1d4f456f41 plus an uncommitted doc edit all passed (17-27 s each).

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 failure in the scoped check ToolRun 033db6ea7cbd381ea400582027fd159a (2026-11-22, leftover FinalizerInventoryWorkerResult after warmup release); 1 phase rerun passed; 3/3 serial land-agent reruns passed. Fail rate roughly 1 in 5 observed runs; not reproduced serially.
